title: Miss probability and cumulative miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $s,t$ be vertices. For every natural number $L$, $(L+1)$ times the probability of missing $t$ in a uniformly chosen length-$L$ sequence of neighbor indices from $s$ is at most the sum of the miss probabilities at times $0$ through $L$.
hypotheses_covered: The multigraph has a finite vertex set V
